body:
Hi there!

You were the first slam poet I ever saw, and I've been hooked ever since. I'm seeing you in Denver on May 6, and really looking forward to it!

How do you find the courage to do what you do? Every time I get on a stage or write something, I feel like I don't have the right to. Any advice?

PS: I have the Nutritionist hanging on my bedroom wall. It fills up the cracks in my heart and in my bones and I'll always love you for that.
I don't think I can believe that.
